script.title: THE MISSING PORCH PACKAGE
script.story_hook: A delivered box disappears from a porch.
script.intro_zh: 送到門口的包裹，不見了。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we report a missing package. Listen for polite asking phrases.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們練習回報遺失的包裹。留意有禮貌的問句。
script.outro: What a lucky ending! Check your porch twice.
script.outro_zh: 真幸運的結局！記得在門口多看兩次。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each reporting line.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在開始，逐句跟讀這些回報說法。
script.char_a_description: an elderly woman in her seventies with short silver curly hair, wearing a mustard yellow cardigan, gray trousers and black flat shoes, warm and gentle
script.char_b_description: a young man in his twenties with short black hair and brown skin, wearing a red plaid button shirt, dark jeans and white sneakers, tall and lean

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, are you the building manager?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi ɑɹ ju ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ ˈmænədʒɚ/
dialogue.zh: 請問，您是大樓管理員嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that's me. How can I help?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæts mi haʊ kæn aɪ hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 是我。我能幫你什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My package vanished from my porch.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpækɪdʒ ˈvænɪʃt fɹʌm maɪ pɔɹtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我的包裹從門口消失了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no. When was it supposed to come?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ wɛn wʌz ɪt səˈpozd tə kʌm/
dialogue.zh: 噢不。它本來幾點到？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tracking said delivered around one fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɹækɪŋ sɛd dɪˈlɪvɚd əˈɹaʊnd wʌn fɪfˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 追蹤顯示一點十五分左右送達。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you check the porch yourself?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju tʃɛk ðə pɔɹtʃ jɜɹˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 你有自己去門口看過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, twice. The box is gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs twaɪs ðə bɑks ɪz ɡɑn/
dialogue.zh: 看了兩次。箱子不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, what did you order?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wʌt dɪd ju ˈɔɹdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好，你訂購了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small box of my reading glasses.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɑl bɑks əv maɪ ˈɹidɪŋ ˈɡlæsəz/
dialogue.zh: 一盒我的老花眼鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anything written on the outside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈɹɪtn ɑn ði aʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 外面有沒有寫東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just my name and unit number.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst maɪ neɪm ænd ˈjunɪt ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 只有我的名字和門牌號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me pull today's delivery log.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi pʊl təˈdeɪz dɪˈlɪvɚi lɑɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我來查今天的送貨紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. It arrived at one oh five.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ɪt əˈɹaɪvd æt wʌn oʊ faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。它一點零五分送到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, the driver left it by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ðə dɹaɪvɚ lɛft ɪt baɪ ðə dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，司機把它放在門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But ten minutes later it was missing!
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt tɛn ˈmɪnəts ˈleɪɾɚ ɪt wʌz ˈmɪsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 可是十分鐘後就不見了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any neighbors see anything this morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈneɪbɚz si ˈɛniθɪŋ ðɪs ˈmɔɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 今早鄰居有看到什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I asked the lady downstairs. Nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æskt ðə ˈleɪdi ˌdaʊnˈstɛɹz ˈnʌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我問過樓下的住戶。她說沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Our cameras cover the lobby door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ˈaʊɚ ˈkæmɚəz ˈkʌvɚ ðə ˈlɑbi dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 了解。我們的攝影機對著大堂門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can they see my porch too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðeɪ si maɪ pɔɹtʃ tu/
dialogue.zh: 那能看到我的門口嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sadly no, the angle misses that side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslædi noʊ ðə ˈæŋɡəl ˈmɪsəz ðæt saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 可惜角度剛好沒拍到那一側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's a shame. What can we do?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts ə ʃeɪm wʌt kæn wi du/
dialogue.zh: 噢，真可惜。我們能做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, I'll write an incident report.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚst aɪl ɹaɪt ən ˈɪnsədənt ɹɪˈpoɹt/
dialogue.zh: 首先，我會寫一份事故報告。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to sign anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə saɪn ˈɛniθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我需要簽名嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just your name and the date, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst jʊɹ neɪm ænd ðə deɪt pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請簽你的名字和日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Should I call the seller too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ʃʊd aɪ kɔl ðə ˈsɛlɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 簽好了。我也該聯絡賣家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, shops usually send a replacement fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʃɑps ˈjuʒəwəli sɛnd ə ɹɪˈpleɪsmənt fæst/
dialogue.zh: 對，賣家通常很快就補寄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But I paid with a coupon. Ugh.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt aɪ peɪd wɪð ə ˈkupɑn ʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 但我用的是折價券。唉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, the report number helps a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə ɹɪˈpɔɹt ˈnʌmbɚ hɛlps ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 有報告編號會很有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you give me that number today?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju ɡɪv mi ðæt ˈnʌmbɚ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天會給我那個編號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it goes on your receipt now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ɪt ɡoʊz ɑn jʊɹ ɹɪˈsit naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 會，編號現在就寫在你收據上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. One more worry, um, my second order.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɚfɪkt wʌn mɔɹ ˈwɜɹi ʌm maɪ ˈsɛkənd ˈɔɹdɚ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。還有一個擔心，呃，我的第二個訂單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A new package is coming this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə nu ˈpækɪdʒ ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ ðɪs wik/
dialogue.zh: 這週還有新包裹要到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! I don't want to lose that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ doʊnt wɑnt tə luz ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 對！我不想再丟一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can hold it here at the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn hoʊld ɪt hɪɹ æt ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以幫你在櫃台收著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That would ease my mind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹɪli ðæt wʊd iz maɪ maɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？那我就安心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just tell the driver 'leave at office'.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tɛl ðə ˈdɹaɪvɚ liv æt ˈɔfəs/
dialogue.zh: 只要註明『放在管理室』。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll add that note tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl æd ðæt noʊt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚就加上備註。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Also, a locker costs ten a month.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt ˈɔlsoʊ ə ˈlɑkɚ kɑsts tɛn ə mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。另外，寄物櫃一個月十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A lockable box right downstairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɑkəbl̩ bɑks ɹaɪt ˌdaʊnˈstɛɹz/
dialogue.zh: 就在樓下的可上鎖箱子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, code opens it just for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs koʊd ˈoʊpənz ɪt dʒʌst fɔɹ ju/
dialogue.zh: 對，只有你的密碼開得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, that sounds worth the money.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ðæt saʊndz wɜɹð ðə ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我覺得值得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll put your name on the list today.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl pʊt jʊɹ neɪm ɑn ðə lɪst təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我今天就把你登記上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you! Oh look, my glasses box!
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju oʊ lʊk maɪ ˈɡlæsəz bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝！咦，我的眼鏡盒！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The driver found it behind the pillar!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɹaɪvɚ faʊnd ɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈpɪlɚ/
dialogue.zh: 司機在柱子後面找到它了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, that's the best ending today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðæts ðə bɛst ˈɛndɪŋ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那今天就是最好的結局了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? Sometimes it's a silly hide-and-seek.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ˈsʌmtaɪmz ɪts ə ˈsɪli haɪd‿ənˈsik/
dialogue.zh: 你看，有時候只是場調皮的捉迷藏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel silly, but so relieved.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ˈsɪli bʌt soʊ ɹɪˈlivd/
dialogue.zh: 我覺得自己好傻，但鬆了口氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No harm done. Keep the report anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ hɑɹm dʌn kip ðə ɹɪˈpɔɹt ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒事就好。報告還是要留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course. Is my report number seven two four?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ɪz maɪ ɹɪˈpɔɹt ˈnʌmbɚ ˈsɛvən tu fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 當然。我的報告編號是七二四嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven two four, exactly. Welcome!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən tu fɔɹ ɪɡˈzæktli ˈwɛlkəm/
dialogue.zh: 正解，七二四。不客氣！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've been such a big help.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz bɪn sʌtʃ ə bɪɡ hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 你幫了我大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime. Want me to note the locker spot?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm wɑnt mi tə noʊt ðə ˈlɑkɚ spɑt/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。要我幫你登記櫃位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please! The sooner, the better.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz ðə ˈsunɚ ðə ˈbɛtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 好啊！越快越好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Now enjoy your new reading glasses!
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn naʊ ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jʊɹ nu ˈɹidɪŋ ˈɡlæsəz/
dialogue.zh: 登記好了。去享受你的新眼鏡吧！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll open them upstairs. Goodbye!
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈoʊpən ðɛm ˌʌpˈstɛɹz ɡʊdˈbaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我上樓再拆封。再見！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, one small thing about your porch.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt wʌn smɑl θɪŋ əˈbaʊt jʊɹ pɔɹtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 等等，關於你的門口還有件小事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, what is it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wʌt ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，什麼事？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bright porch light keeps thieves away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɹaɪt pɔɹtʃ laɪt kips θivz əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 門口裝一盞亮燈，小偷就不敢靠近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great tip. I'll buy one this weekend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt tɪp aɪl baɪ wʌn ðɪs ˈwikˈɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 好建議。這週末我就買。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have a wonderful evening, and welcome home!
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ə ˈwʌndɚfəl ˈivnɪŋ ænd ˈwɛlkəm hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 祝你有個美好的晚上，歡迎回家！

script.youtube_title_en: "A Silly Hide-and-Seek" — Reporting a Stolen Porch Package
script.youtube_description:
60句包裹遺失聽力練習：到管理室報案、查送達時間、看監視畫面，再把補寄與保管的說法一次學會。

這一集跟著一位住戶走訪管理室：包裹送到門口卻消失了，管理員查紀錄、寫事故報告、想辦法讓下一個包裹不再迷路，結尾還有溫暖的小反轉。

你會聽到：
- 回報包裹遺失的禮貌問句
- 送貨紀錄與監視器畫面的說法
- 事故報告編號怎麼用、如何請賣家補寄
- 櫃台代收與密碼寄物櫃的選擇

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，把這些句子聽熟、說順。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每天一集生活情境英文聽力！
script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of lost-package listening practice: a resident reports a package missing from her porch, and the building manager checks the delivery log, files an incident report, and sets up lockers and desk pickup for the next one.

You will hear polite reporting questions, delivery and camera vocabulary, and friendly small talk, ending with a sweet little twist. The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for daily-life English listening videos every week.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
包裹送到門口卻不見了，該找誰？監視器沒拍到，又該怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進公寓管理室，跟著一位阿嬤和年輕管理員，從查送貨紀錄到寫事故報告，一步一步把遺失包裹問清楚。

你會聽到：
📦 回報遺失：「My package vanished from my porch.」
🎥 查監視畫面：「Sadly no, the angle misses that side.」

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 先把整段對話聽熟，再一句一句開口模仿，讓句子自然變成口語習慣。
